technique_name: Find one historical event in the 15th century (1400s) and describe it briefly.
description: In the 15th century, there was an event that had a major impact on the world - the fall of Constantinople. On May 29th, 1453, the Ottoman army defeated the Byzantine Empire and captured Constantinople, which led to the end of the Roman Empire and a major shift in the geopolitical landscape. Constantinople, once a major center of trade and cultural exchange, fell to the Ottoman Turks and turned into an Islamic city.
